title: Second incompleteness: why arithmetic cannot prove its own consistency
proposed_plain_text_title_and_id: **Second incompleteness: why arithmetic cannot prove its own consistency** — `second-incompleteness`
main_result_and_scope: Establish internal D2 and D3 for a specified concrete proof predicate over PA, then prove second incompleteness and Löb's theorem for its consistency sentence. A different representative requires a proved comparison; standard-model correctness alone is insufficient.
